newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares rally on Pudong share rising.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares rally on Pudong share rising.

text.p: Shanghai B shares rallied due to the strong performance of Pudong shares on Monday, but trading remained sluggish with most investors sidelined, brokers said.
The index rose 0.302 points or 0.63 percent to 48.588 points on volume of 4.8 million shares worth $1.7 million. Of 41 B shares, 33 traded with 13 up, 13 flat and seven down.
Brokers said domestic institutional buying of Pudong shares drove the index up, but follow-up buying was limited due to a lack of positive market-moving news.
Pudong share Shanghai Jinqiao Development rose $0.016 or 4.57 percent to $0.366 on volume of 406,000 shares.
Shanghai Lujiazui, a second Pudong share, traded the most, rising $0.020 or 2.16 percent to $0.944 on volume of 509,300 shares.
"Obviously the rise was only a technical rebound. The thin trading volume indicated no fresh capital flow in the market," one broker said.
"The market is still on a downward track and investors were cautious to buy now," a second broker said.
Shanghai Huili Building Materials was the star on speculative buying, ending up $0.010 or 5.74 percent to $0.184 on volume of 26,000 shares.
Shanghai A shares soared on bullish market sentiment, and further rises are expected in the short term with fresh capital flowing in from the futures markets, brokers said.

The A index jumped 33.070 points or 3.46 percent to 989.236 points on volume of 194.5 million shares worth 8.7 billion yuan. The SSE 30 blue chip index rose 44.229 points or 1.77 percent to 2540.043 points.
Nanjing Fibre was the star on speculative buying in the latter part of the session, surging 1.02 yuan or 20.00 percent to 6.12 yuan on volume of 3.7 million shares.
